variety_description: A high yielding, medium maturity, medium height, long slender variety suitable for cultivation across country under irrigated lowland growing conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2017 for planting in Boro season having higher yield than commonly grown variety BRRI dhan28. Susceptible to leaf blast. Cold sensitive.  Premium export quality rice. Excellent taste.
